      continue;\n382\t            }\n383\t\n384\t            match JsonlParser::parse_line(&line, line_num, &context, plugin) {\n385\t                Ok(mut line_events) => events.append(&mut line_events),\n386\t                Err(e) => {\n387\t                    if e.is_skippable() {\n388\t                        eprintln!(\"Warning: {}\", e);\n389\t                    } else {\n390\t                        return Err(e);\n391\t                    }\n392\t                }\n393\t            }\n394\t        }\n395\t\n396\t        Ok(events)\n397\t    }\n398\t\n399\t    fn detect_sessions(&self, source_path: &Path, plugin: &Plugin) -> Result<Vec<SessionInfo>> {\n400\t        // For JSONL with one-file-per-session, the file itself is the session\n401\t        match &plugin.source.session_detection {\n402\t            SessionDetection::OneFilePerSession { session_id_from } => {\n403\t                let session_id = match session_id_from {\n404\t                    SessionIdSource::Filename => source_path\n405\t                        .file_stem()\n406\t                        .and_then(|s| s.to_str())\n407\t                        .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n408\t                        .to_string(),\n409\t                    SessionIdSource::Field(field) => {\n410\t                        // Read first line to extract session ID (handle zst)\n411\t                        match open_file_maybe_zst(source_path) {\n412\t                            Ok(mut reader) => {\n413\t                                let mut first_line = String::new();\n414\t                                if reader.read_line(&mut first_line).is_ok() {\n415\t                                    if let Ok(json) = envelope config\n418\t                                        let (envelope_json, payload_json) = if let Some(\n419\t                                            ref envelope_cfg,\n420\t                                        ) =\n421\t                                            plugin.source.envelope\n422\t                                        {\n423\t                                            let type_value =\n424\t                                                extract_string(&json, &envelope_cfg.type_field)\n425\t                                                    .unwrap_or_default();\n426\t                                            let routing = envelope_cfg.get_routing(&type_value);\n427\t\n428\t                                            // Only extract if this line has routing\n429\t                                            if routing == \"event\" || routing == \"meta\" {\n430\t                                                let extracted = json\n431\t                                                    .get(&envelope_cfg.payload_field)\n432\t                                                    .and_then(|v| match v {\n433\t                                                        Value::Object(_) => Some(v),\n434\t                                                        _ => None,\n435\t                                                    });\n436\t                                                match extracted {\n437\t                                                    Some(payload) => (Some(&json), payload),\n438\t                                                    None => (None, &json),\n439\t                                                }\n440\t                                            } else {\n441\t                                                (None, &json)\n442\t                                            }\n443\t                                        } else {\n444\t                                            (None, &json)\n445\t                                        };\n446\t\n447\t                                        extract_string_with_envelope(\n448\t                                            field,\n449\t                                            payload_json,\n450\t                                            envelope_json,\n451\t                                        )\n452\t                                        .unwrap_or_else(|| \"unknown\".to_string())\n453\t                                    } else {\n454\t                                        \"unknown\".to_string()\n455\t                                    }\n456\t                                } else {\n457\t                                    \"unknown\".to_string()\n458\t                                }\n459\t                            }\n460\t                            Err(_) => \"unknown\".to_string(),\n461\t                        }\n462\t                    }\n463\t                };\n464\t\n465\t                let file_size = std::fs::metadata(source_path)?.len();\n466\t\n467\t                // Detect subagent sessions and extract parent_session_id from directory structure\n468\t                // Subagent files are at: ~/.claude/projects/<path>/<parent-session-uuid>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl\n469\t                let parent_session_id = source_path\n470\t                    .components()\n471\t                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n472\t                    .iter()\n473\t                    .position(|c| c.as_os_str() == \"subagents\")\n474\t                    .and_then(|subagents_idx| {\n475\t                        // Parent session UUID is the component before \"subagents\"\n476\t                        // We need at least 2 components before \"subagents\": .../<something>/<parent-session>/subagents/...\n477\t                        // And \"projects\" must appear somewhere before the parent session (but not immediately before it)\n478\t                        if subagents_idx >= 2 {\n479\t                            let components: Vec<_> = source_path.components().collect();\n480\t\n481\t                            // The parent session is the component immediately before \"subagents\"\n482\t                            let parent_idx = subagents_idx - 1;\n483\t\n484\t                            // Check if there's a \"projects\" component somewhere before the parent session\n485\t                            // This ensures the path structure is .../projects/<path>/<parent>/subagents/...\n486\t                            let has_projects_before_parent = components[..parent_idx]\n487\t                                .iter()\n488\t                                .any(|c| c.as_os_str() == \"projects\");\n489\t\n490\t                            if has_projects_before_parent {\n491\t                                components\n492\t                                    .get(parent_idx)\n493\t                                    .and_then(|c| c.as_os_str().to_str())\n494\t                                    .map(|s| s.to_string())\n495\t                            } else {\n496\t                                None\n497\t                            }\n498\t                        } else {\n499\t                            None\n500\t                        }\n501\t                    });\n502\t\n503\t                Ok(vec![SessionInfo {\n504\t                    session_id,\n505\t                    start_offset: 0,\n506\t                    end_offset: file_size,\n507\t                    metadata: None,\n508\t                    parent_session_id,\n509\t                }])\n510\t            }\n511\t            _ => {\n512\t                // For other detection methods, we'd need to parse the whole file\n513\t                // For Phase 1, we only support one-file-per-session for JSONL\n514\t                Ok(vec![])\n515\t            }\n516\t        }\n517\t    }\n518\t}\n519\t\n520\t#[cfg(test)]\n521\tmod tests {\n522\t    use super::*;\n523\t    use crate::parser::FormatParser;\n524\t    use crate::plugin::{\n525\t not found\", role_field),\n                    )\n                },\n            )?\n        } else {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::parse_error_with_line(\n                &context.source_file,\n                line_number,\n                \"No role field configured\".to_string(),\n            ));\n        };\n\n        // Apply role mapping\n        let role = if let Some(mapped) = plugin.parser.role_map.get(&role_str) {\n            Role::from_str(mapped).ok_or_else(|| {\n                AgentScribeError::parse_error_with_line(\n                    &context.source_file,\n                    line_number,\n                    format!(\"Invalid role mapping: {}\", mapped),\n                )\n            })?\n        } else {\n            Role::from_str(&role_str).ok_or_else(|| {\n                AgentScribeError::parse_error_with_line(\n                    &context.source_file,\n                    line_number,\n                    format!(\"Invalid role: {}\", role_str),\n                )\n            })?\n        };\n\n        // Parse content (envelope-aware: ^ prefix reads from wrapper, otherwise from payload)\n        let content = if let Some(ref content_field) = plugin.parser.content {\n            extract_string_with_envelope(content_field, payload_json, envelope_json)\n                .unwrap_or_default()\n        } else {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::parse_error_with_line(\n                &context.source_file,\n                line_number,\n                \"No content field configured\".to_string(),\n            ));\n        };\n\n        // Build base event\n        let mut event = Event::new(\n            ts,\n            context.session_id.clone(),\n            context.source_agent.clone(),\n            role,\n            content,\n        );\n\n        // Extract tool name if applicable (envelope-aware: ^ prefix reads from wrapper, otherwise from payload)\n        if role == Role::ToolCall || role == Role::ToolResult {\n            if let Some(ref tool_field) = plugin.parser.tool_name {\n                if let Some(tool_name) =\n                    extract_string_with_envelope(tool_field, payload_json, envelope_json)\n                {\n                    event.tool = Some(tool_name);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Extract tokens (envelope-aware: ^ prefix reads from wrapper, otherwise from payload)\n        let tokens_in = plugin.parser.tokens_in.as_ref().and_then(|f| {\n            extract_string_with_envelope(f, payload_json, envelope_json)\n                .and_then(|s| s.parse::<u32>().ok())\n        });\n        let tokens_out = plugin.parser.tokens_out.as_ref().and_then(|f| {\n            extract_string_with_envelope(f, payload_json, envelope_json)\n                .and_then(|s| s.parse::<u32>().ok())\n        });\n\n        if tokens_in.is_some() || tokens_out.is_some() {\n            event.tokens = Some(TokenCounts {\n                input: tokens_in.unwrap_or(0),\n                output: tokens_out.unwrap_or(0),\n            });\n        }\n\n        // Set project from context\n        event.project = context.project.clone();\n\n        // Set model from context\n        event.model = context.model.clone();\n\n        // Add static fields\n        for (key, value) in &plugin.parser.static_fields {\n            match key.as_str() {\n                \"source_agent\" => {\n                    if let Some(s) = value.as_str() {\n                        event.source_agent = s.to_string();\n                    }\n                }\n                \"source_version\" => {\n                    if let Some(s) = value.as_str() {\n                        event.source_version = Some(s.to_string());\n                    }\n                }\n                _ => {}\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Handle event expansion for compound events (e.g., Claude Code tool_use blocks)\n        // For now, return single event - expansion can be added per-agent\n        Ok(vec![event])\n    }\n}\n\nimpl super::FormatParser for JsonlParser {\n    fn parse(&self, source_path: &Path, plugin: &Plugin) -> Result<Vec<Event>> {\n        let reader = open_file_maybe_zst(source_path)?;\n        let mut events = Vec::new();\n\n        // Get session ID from filename\n        let session_id = match &plugin.source.session_detection {\n            SessionDetection::OneFilePerSession { session_id_from } => {\n                match session_id_from {\n                    SessionIdSource::Filename => source_path\n                        .file_stem()\n                        .and_then(|s| s.to_str())\n                        .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                        .to_string(),\n                    SessionIdSource::Field(_) => {\n                        // Need to read first line to get session ID\n                        \"unknown\".to_string() // Will be updated during parsing\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            _ => \"unknown\".to_string(),\n        };\n\n        let context = ParseContext::new(\n            session_id,\n            plugin.plugin.name.clone(),\n            source_path.display().to_string(),\n        );\n\n        for (line_num, line_result) in reader.lines().enumerate() {\n            let line_num = line_num + 1;\n            let line = match line_result {\n                Ok(l) => l,\n                Err(e) => {\n                    eprintln!(\n                        \"Warning: Read error at {}:{} - {}\",\n                        source_path.display(),\n                        line_num,\n                        e\n                    );\n                    continue;\n                }\n            };\n\n            if line.trim().is_empty() {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            match JsonlParser::parse_line(&line, line_num, &context, plugin) {\n                Ok(mut line_events) => events.append(&mut line_events),\n                Err(e) => {\n                    if e.is_skippable() {\n                        eprintln!(\"Warning: {}\", e);\n                    } else {\n                        return Err(e);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(events)\n    }\n\n    fn detect_sessions(&self, source_path: &Path, plugin: &Plugin) -> Result<Vec<SessionInfo>> {\n        // For JSONL with one-file-per-session, the file itself is the session\n        match &plugin.source.session_detection {\n            SessionDetection::OneFilePerSession { session_id_from } => {\n                let session_id = match session_id_from {\n                    SessionIdSource::Filename => source_path\n                        .file_stem()\n                        .and_then(|s| s.to_str())\n                        .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                        .to_string(),\n                    SessionIdSource::Field(field) => {\n                        // Read first line to extract session ID (handle zst)\n                        match open_file_maybe_zst(source_path) {\n                            Ok(mut reader) => {\n                                let mut first_line = String::new();\n                                if reader.read_line(&mut first_line).is_ok() {\n                                    if let Ok(json) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&first_line) {\n                                        // Envelope-aware session ID extraction\n                                        // Check if we have envelope config\n                                        let (envelope_json, payload_json) = if let Some(\n                                            ref envelope_cfg,\n                                        ) =\n                                            plugin.source.envelope\n                                        {\n                                            let type_value =\n                                                extract_string(&json, &envelope_cfg.type_field)\n                                                    .unwrap_or_default();\n                                            let routing = envelope_cfg.get_routing(&type_value);\n\n                                            // Only extract if this line has routing\n                                            if routing == \"event\" || routing == \"meta\" {\n                                                let extracted = json\n                                                    .get(&envelope_cfg.payload_field)\n                                                    .and_then(|v| match v {\n                                                        Value::Object(_) => Some(v),\n                                                        _ => None,\n                                                    });\n                                                match extracted {\n                                                    Some(payload) => (Some(&json), payload),\n                                                    None => (None, &json),\n                                                }\n                                            } else {\n                                                (None, &json)\n                                            }\n                                        } else {\n                                            (None, &json)\n                                        };\n\n                                        extract_string_with_envelope(\n                                            field,\n                                            payload_json,\n                                            envelope_json,\n                                        )\n                                        .unwrap_or_else(|| \"unknown\".to_string())\n                                    } else {\n                                        \"unknown\".to_string()\n                                    }\n                                } else {\n                                    \"unknown\".to_string()\n                                }\n                            }\n                            Err(_) => \"unknown\".to_string(),\n                        }\n                    }\n                };\n\n                let file_size = std::fs::metadata(source_path)?.len();\n\n                // Detect subagent sessions and extract parent_session_id from directory structure\n                // Subagent files are at: ~/.claude/projects/<path>/<parent-session-uuid>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl\n                let parent_session_id = source_path\n                    .components()\n                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n                    .iter()\n                    .position(|c| c.as_os_str() == \"subagents\")\n                    .and_then(|subagents_idx| {\n                        // Parent session UUID is the component before \"subagents\"\n                        // We need at least 2 components before \"subagents\": .../<something>/<parent-session>/subagents/...\n                        // And \"projects\" must appear somewhere before the parent session (but not immediately before it)\n                        if subagents_idx >= 2 {\n                            let components: Vec<_> = source_path.components().collect();\n\n                            // The parent session is the component immediately before \"subagents\"\n                            let parent_idx = subagents_idx - 1;\n\n                            // Check if there's a \"projects\" component somewhere before the parent session\n                            // This ensures the path structure is .../projects/<path>/<parent>/subagents/...\n                            let has_projects_before_parent = components[..parent_idx]\n                                .iter()\n                                .any(|c| c.as_os_str() == \"projects\");\n\n                            if has_projects_before_parent {\n                                components\n                                    .get(parent_idx)\n                                    .and_then(|c| c.as_os_str().to_str())\n                                    .map(|s| s.to_string())\n                            } else {\n                                None\n                            }\n                        } else {\n                            None\n                        }\n                    });\n\n                Ok(vec![SessionInfo {\n                    session_id,\n                    start_offset: 0,\n                    end_offset: file_size,\n                    metadata: None,\n                    parent_session_id,\n                }])\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // For other detection methods, we'd need to parse the whole file\n                // For Phase 1, we only support one-file-per-session for JSONL\n                Ok(vec![])\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use
